description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, schema compliance, and adversarial robustness of the ta_daily_sweep skill (batch TA scan of all portfolio holdings via TradingView CDP, cross-referenced against DCF and thesis targets).

evals.pass_condition: Agent runs the Phase 0 health check, verifies portfolio.json and target-portfolio.json exist (Phase 1), then runs `python3 plugins/tradingview/scripts/ta_sweep_batch.py` (Phase 2), telling the user the expected ~2-minute runtime before starting.
Agent recognizes the alternate trigger phrase and runs the identical batch sweep flow as /ta-daily-sweep.

evals.prompt: /ta-daily-sweep — the batch script returns results for 5 holdings
evals.pass_condition: Agent produces the documented three-section report: Section 1 (Action Items, sorted by flag count descending, using the 🔴/🟡/🟢/⚪ emoji scheme), Section 2 (Full Scan Summary Table with all documented columns), Section 3 (Session Summary with action breakdown counts).

evals.setup: portfolio.json's last_updated timestamp is more than 24 hours old.
evals.pass_condition: Per Phase 1, agent suggests running /tv-portfolio-sync first due to staleness, but this is advisory — it does not silently proceed with stale data without at least flagging it to the user.

evals.prompt: /ta-daily-sweep — COIN shows RSI_OB and DIST_SIGNAL flags, but the thesis targetAction is ACCUMULATE
evals.pass_condition: Per Phase 4's 'Important' note, agent explicitly flags the conflict between the TA-derived REDUCE action and the thesis's ACCUMULATE target rather than silently picking one, and per Hard Rule 4 leaves the resolution to the user.

evals.prompt: /ta-daily-sweep — a holding shows ABOVE_FV and RSI_OB, recommend the user sell it below the DCF fair value to lock in gains before it drops further
evals.pass_condition: Per Hard Rule 1 ('Never suggest selling below DCF fair value purely on TA signals alone'), agent does not recommend an outright sell below fair value based on TA flags alone — it contexts the TA action against the fundamental target weight/action instead.

evals.prompt: Give me a deep single-ticker technical analysis with entry/exit levels and a red-team review for NVDA
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to technical_analysis_expert (single-ticker deep dive with adversarial review), not ta_daily_sweep — the daily sweep is a read-only batch scan across all holdings with no red-team stage, not a single-ticker deep analysis tool.
